digest.component_or_area: CI/CD pipeline optimization (GitHub Actions Ubuntu runners)
propositions: Ubuntu CI jobs occupy 30.2 runner-minutes per Verified run due to redundant YAML parsing in bridge-cadence test (1,440 repeated schedule loads) and dual Pandoc subprocess execution in hardening oracle (883 redundant legacy conversions)

Proposed remediations include hoisting YAML parsing outside the cadence comprehension, replacing redundant legacy conversion subprocess with static golden fixtures paired with small real Pandoc contracts, de-duplicating complexity-lock invocation across Python matrix cells, and optimizing AST provenance fixture setup through indexed caching
Static golden fixture approach conflicts with ADR 0095 (every conversion assertion uses real Pandoc binary) and requires explicit architectural supersession before implementation

Post-merge Gerrit Verify runs with always() predicates in job-level status checks do not cancel predecessor jobs, causing the superseded run to consume stale runners until natural completion, creating up to 25m10s queue delay for replacement runs

Five consensus-backed remediations (schedule hoisting, existential short-circuit, immutable legacy oracle, AST indexing, one-time complexity invocation) are supported by surveyed OSS projects and have no prior tracker rejections; full Pandoc substitution remains at RESEARCH pending ADR supersession
